title: feat(spec,driver-sql,service-datasource): Oracle Database as a federation dialect — read live, write behind both opt-ins, never managed
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiCoB7HoenXh7jmQHqPgnxH8)_

Fixes #31328

## What changes

Oracle Database becomes a **federation dialect** of `driver-sql`. An external datasource over Oracle reads live, and writes when both write opt-ins are on. It is never managed.

**`@objectstack/spec`**
- The `oracle` driver row (alias `oracledb`) is federation-only. It is `hasLocalDefault: false` and never a boot selection. A `managed` oracle datasource, including the default mode, is refused at `defineStack` at path `schemaMode`, and the message names the scope and the fix.
- `OracleConfigSchema` (`driver/oracle.zod.ts`): `connectString`, or `host` / `port` (default 1521) / `serviceName`, plus `username`. `password`, `url` and the TLS keys are refused by name, each with the spelling that works.
- A datasource `ssl` block that asks for TLS is refused on oracle. Thin mode takes TLS from a `tcps://` connect string and the factory never hands the block to the driver, so the block would be dropped. A private certificate authority is reached through a PEM wallet the connect string names (`?wallet_location=DIR` holding `ewallet.pem`, or `(SECURITY=(MY_WALLET_DIRECTORY=DIR))` in a descriptor); the connect string reaches the driver verbatim. That route follows node-oracledb 6.10's Thin-mode source and has not been run against a live TLS listener.
- Type-compat `SqlDialect` gains `'oracle'`, with `DIALECT_ALIASES.oracle` and parameterised `NUMBER(p,s)` / `RAW(16)` handling. On oracle every field pairing over a `RAW(16)` uuid column (`lookup` included) is `'lossy'`, so a draft carries a review marker until #31390 binds the uuid string back to RAW.
- ADR-0015 §4.6 lists Oracle, and §5.1 names the DDL gate's federation-only arm. This is governed and owes a CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER review.

**`@objectstack/driver-sql`**
- `client: 'oracledb'` uses a knex client subclass over node-oracledb **Thin** mode. `oracledb` is an optional peer.
- Paging uses `OFFSET … ROWS FETCH NEXT … ROWS ONLY`, so the minimum version is **Oracle 12c R1**.
- Identifiers are quoted as the catalog folds them (UPPER).
- `LIKE` gets a bound `ESCAPE`. `$contains` is case-exact, and `$icontains` folds ASCII only through `translate()`.
- A `NUMBER(1)` flag reads as a boolean, and a boolean writes 1 / 0. `BOOLEAN` is native on 23ai.
- Temporal values: datetime and date comparands and writes bind as instants (`TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE`) on a UTC session. The fetch path repairs Thin's local-clock decode of `DATE` / `TIMESTAMP`. `RAW(16)` reads as a UUID string. Date buckets use `to_char(sys_extract_utc(…))`.
- Introspection runs four catalog reads, scoped to `SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','CURRENT_SCHEMA')`: ALL_TABLES, ALL_TAB_COLUMNS, and PK/unique and FK from ALL_CONSTRAINTS. A cross-schema FK parent carries `referencedSchema`.
- Refusals:
  - every DDL operation: `UnsupportedDialectEmissionError`, reason `federation-only`;
  - a `''` comparand on `= $eq $ne $in $nin $gt $gte $lt $lte $between`: `INVALID_FILTER`, withheld subtree. Oracle stores `''` as NULL, so the comparison would silently mean IS NULL;
  - JSON-array membership: `INVALID_FILTER`;
  - upsert: `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` / 501. No MERGE is emitted, and the docs state this.
- **Arms found only on the live server**, not in the card. Each has a compile pin and a live pin:
  - `$empty` on a text column compiles as IS NULL / IS NOT NULL. `= ''` / `<> ''` compare against NULL there, so `$empty: false` answered no rows.
  - A `Date` comparand against a NON-temporal column binds as its canonical ISO text. Bound as a TIMESTAMP, it made Oracle convert the text column, which raised on every non-timestamp row.

**`@objectstack/service-datasource`**
- The shared factory has an oracle arm. It composes `host:port/serviceName` or passes `connectString` verbatim, and the password is the bound secret. A legacy stored `ssl` block is refused at this last door too.
- `oracledb` joins `OPTIONAL_DRIVER_CLIENT_PACKAGES`, so a missing package is answered with its install. This is pinned through the real factory and boot path.

**Docs:** `external-datasources.mdx` gains an Oracle section covering the config shape, minimum version, Thin mode, TLS, value mapping, introspection scope, and every refusal including the upsert 501.

## Pre-existing defects found here: ported separately, now on main

Oracle made three defects visible that exist on **every dialect**, because every Oracle table is bound through `external.columnMap` (its columns are UPPER-case): `aggregate()` / `distinct()` and `update()` / `delete()` / `bulkDelete()` named the field instead of the mapped column, and a paged read got no unique tie-breaker. They were carried here as temporary commits and ported to `main` through #31340 and #31342. Both have landed, and main is merged, so none of those commits or changesets remain in this PR's diff.

## Why

#31328: federation over the Oracle estates that customers already run, with no ETL.

## Verification

- **Live conformance:** `sql-driver-oracle-federation-conformance.test.ts` runs against gvenzl/oracle-free 23ai: **261/261 pass**, under `TZ=America/New_York` and again under `TZ=Asia/Shanghai`. The same harness runs on SQLite as a control: raw remote DDL, `columnMap`, external mode, rows written through `create()`.
  - Case-sets run: `FILTER_LOGIC_CASES`, `FILTER_TEXT_CASES`, `PAGINATION_CASES`, `PAGINATION_UNORDERED_CASES`, `PAGINATION_ZERO_LIMIT_CASES`, `FILTER_COMPARAND_TYPE_CASES` (the executed half; the door-refusal half is dialect-free and pinned elsewhere), `AGGREGATION_CASES`, `TEMPORAL_CASES`.
  - Not run, each with its reason:
    - `TEMPORAL_TIME_CASES`: Oracle has no TIME type, so a remote time-of-day column has no single storage form to hold the set to.
    - `VALUE_ROUNDTRIP_CASES`, `READABLE_IDS_CASES`, `UNIQUE_NULL_DISTINCT_CASES`: they pin the driver's OWN managed storage forms and indexes, which a federation-only dialect never creates.
    - `BULK_WRITE_HOOK`: an engine-layer contract, not a dialect one.
  - **CI does not provision Oracle.** Without `OS_TEST_ORACLE_URL` the Oracle cell is a **named skip** ("is provisioned — set OS_TEST_ORACLE_URL…"), never a pass. `OS_EXPECT_LIVE_ORACLE=1` turns that skip into a failure. The cell lives in `live-dialect-matrix.testkit.ts` as `ORACLE_CELL`, outside `DIALECT_CELLS`, and `OS_EXPECT_LIVE_DIALECT_MATRIX` does not apply to it.
- **Compile-level pins:** 41 in `sql-driver-oracle-dialect.test.ts`, covering every emitter arm and refusal. The two new builders have refusal-seam rows.
- **Also verified live** beyond the conformance file: create (with and without id; a RAW(16) default reads back as a uuid), update, updateMany, delete, bulkCreate, deleteMany, introspection (PK, composite PK, single-column unique, FK, types), BOOLEAN / NUMBER(1) / CLOB reads.
- **Suites at cdd0a22c8:** driver-sql 4066 passed / 219 skipped; the live Oracle conformance file 261/261. service-datasource 1285 passed. spec `src/data` 6051 passed. `check:generated` fresh, and `check:test-typecheck` OK with an 8 GB heap.
- Dispatch gates: posted in the os-dev-report comment.

**Known limitations (in the docs):**
- During a DST spring-forward gap hour in a non-UTC server process, the read repair is off by the gap. Running with `TZ=UTC` removes the gap.
- A `NUMBER` above 2^53 loses precision.
- Filtering or writing a `RAW(16)` column by its uuid string is unsupported; the type matrix flags those pairings `'lossy'`. `HEXTORAW` binding: #31390.
- Introspection lists the current schema only. Another owner's table is bound by `remoteName: 'OWNER.TABLE'`.
- Oracle is not yet offered in the Studio driver catalog's connection form: #31389.

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added

Changed lines: 2851 (+2765 / -86), under the 3000 threshold.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
